units.source_text: 从这时候起，我决定强迫自己回想老师那活像动物的脑袋和丑陋的肉体。

en.t: From that time on, I decided to force myself to recall the teacher's animal-like head and ugly body.

units.source_text: 想像着他排便的姿态，甚至他与身穿褐红色大衣的女人共寝的姿态。

en.t: I imagined him in the act of defecating, and even imagined him lying with the woman in the reddish-brown coat.

units.source_text: 幻想着他的无表情松弛了，他的快感松弛了，脸上露出了似欢笑又似痛苦的表情。

en.t: I pictured his expressionless face slackening, his pleasure slackening too, and an expression appearing on his face that seemed both laughter and pain.
